name: online suffix tree construction
mechanism: extend a compressed trie of all suffixes one character at a time, using suffix links and an active point so each extension costs amortised constant time

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Ukkonen's algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Substrings: a linear-time, online algorithm for constructing suffix trees
